From: Greg Kroah-Hartman <[email]>

Description
===========

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

openvswitch: defer tunnel netdev_put to RCU release

ovs_netdev_tunnel_destroy() may run after NETDEV_UNREGISTER already
detached the device. Dropping the netdev reference in destroy can race
with concurrent readers that still observe vport->dev.

Do not release vport->dev in ovs_netdev_tunnel_destroy(). Instead, let
vport_netdev_free() drop the reference from the RCU callback, matching
the non-tunnel destroy path and avoiding additional synchronization
under RTNL.

The Linux kernel CVE team has assigned CVE-2026-31678 to this issue.

Affected and fixed versions
===========================

	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 6.1.168 with commit 9d56aced21fb9c104e8a3f3be9b21fbafe448ffc
	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 6.6.131 with commit 42f0d3d81209654c08ffdde5a34b9b92d2645896
	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 6.12.80 with commit bbe7bd722bfaea36aab3da6cc60fb4a05c644643
	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 6.18.21 with commit 98b726ab5e2a4811e27c28e4d041f75bba147eab
	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 6.19.11 with commit b8c56a3fc5d879c0928f207a756b0f067f06c6a8
	Issue introduced in 4.3 with commit a9020fde67a6eb77f8130feff633189f99264db1 and fixed in 7.0 with commit 6931d21f87bc6d657f145798fad0bf077b82486c

Please see https://www.kernel.org for a full list of currently supported
kernel versions by the kernel community.

Unaffected versions might change over time as fixes are backported to
older supported kernel versions.  The official CVE entry at
	https://cve.org/CVERecord/?id=CVE-2026-31678
will be updated if fixes are backported, please check that for the most
up to date information about this issue.

Affected files
==============

The file(s) affected by this issue are:
	net/openvswitch/vport-netdev.c

Mitigation
==========

The Linux kernel CVE team recommends that you update to the latest
stable kernel version for this, and many other bugfixes.  Individual
changes are never tested alone, but rather are part of a larger kernel
release.  Cherry-picking individual commits is not recommended or
supported by the Linux kernel community at all.  If however, updating to
the latest release is impossible, the individual changes to resolve this
issue can be found at these commits:
